STEP 1 - Vessel type: The food sits on a white square-ish flat plate with a rim band and a flat centre, no inner wall visible. Flat plate.

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type: square plates are 20-30 cm. The plate here looks like a large dinner plate, so about 26-28 cm across.
b) Reference: the salad leaves and pizza slice are about 10-12 cm long. The pizza slice (roughly a bread-slice-sized wedge at ~11 cm) spans a good part of the right edge, and the plate's width across the photo is roughly 2.3-2.5 pizza-slice lengths, giving about 25 cm.
Reconciled width: about 26 cm square.

STEP 3 - Food items:
- Caesar-style salad (romaine, dressing, parmesan shavings): covers roughly 25% of plate area. Footprint ≈ 0.25 x 676 cm² ≈ 170 cm². Average thickness about 2 cm (leaves piled). Volume ≈ 340 ml; cooked-greens-with-dressing density ~0.4 g/ml effective → ~135 g.
- Mixed greens with cucumber, cherry tomato and beet/vegetable pieces: footprint ~8% ≈ 55 cm², thickness ~1.5 cm, ≈ 80 ml, chopped vegetable density 0.6 → ~50 g.
- Pizza slice (cheese and tomato sauce, crust): one slice, about 1/8 of a 30 cm pie. Roughly 110 g.
- Grilled chicken pieces (about 4 visible chunks with herb sauce): ~3 cm pieces, about 80 g.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: the pizza slice sits over a thin layer of crust/chicken remnants, already included. No deep base layer. The total is a modest single plate, not a heaped one.

STEP 5 - kcal per 100 g (as served):
- Caesar salad with dressing: ~150 kcal/100 g
- Mixed vegetables: ~30 kcal/100 g
- Cheese pizza: ~265 kcal/100 g
- Grilled chicken with sauce: ~170 kcal/100 g

Totals: about 375 g and roughly 2,000 kJ (≈ 480 kcal)... computed per item: salad 135 g × 1.5 = 203 kcal; greens 50 g × 0.3 = 15 kcal; pizza 110 g × 2.65 = 292 kcal; chicken 80 g × 1.7 = 136 kcal. Total ≈ 645 kcal.
